question: C1 is related to F 4 in a certain way. In the same way, J 6 is related to M 9. To which of the following is P 4 related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'C 1' is related to 'F 4'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d8ff107a8efd9d3fa414c273a6af36914f1fc8c139091b924e86ef0475d1631.png] 

'J 6' is related to 'M 9'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea0f24fa916b7fcd1f236042ec42d646f73114973875647bdc4b70f20140084c.png] 

Similarly, for 'P 4'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ac890b26dd4e7662f215898522df8ae0c579b85887557e3729dffe3ff36adbf.png] 

So, 'P 4' is related by 'S 7'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
